description: Queensland Reconstruction Authority Regional Works Pipeline is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Queensland Reconstruction Authority. The Pipeline of works for events actively managed by the Authority (2009 to 2014) has an estimated program value of nearly $14 billion, the status of which is set out in this dataset. Works Under Assessment and Works in Market represents data as at 31 March 2014 (DTMR) and 31 March 2014 (LGAs and Other). Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Queensland Reconstruction Authority. Its tags are Bushfires, Cyclones, Floods, NDRRA, Natural Disasters. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
